scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('public/build', 'dist/build', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('public/images', 'dist/images', {recursive: true}); if (fs.existsSync('public/favicon.ico')) fs.copyFileSync('public/favicon.ico', 'dist/favicon.ico'); if (fs.existsSync('public/robots.txt')) fs.copyFileSync('public/robots.txt', 'dist/robots.txt');"
